senses.gloss: शिथिल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Loose, loosened, slackened, unfastened, lax; 2. languid, weak, unnerved; 3. ineffective, un-energetic; 4. decayed; 5. dissolved; 6. not strictly performed, loosely observed.
शिथिल (II) n. Laxity, slowness.(शिथिलीकृ 1. to make loose; 2. to make languid, to enfeeble; 3. to give up, to abandon.)
शिथिल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Loose, loosened, slackened, unfastened, lax; 2. languid, weak, unnerved; 3. ineffective, un-energetic; 4. decayed; 5. dissolved; 6. not strictly performed, loosely observed.
